record.clinical_notes: T2DM x 6 yrs, presented c/o vomiting, abdominal pain, altered sensorium x 2 days. RBS 485 mg/dL, ABG: pH 7.18, HCO3 9, ketonuria 3+ - DKA. Precipitant: UTI + non-compliance. ICU care: IV insulin infusion, fluid resuscitation, K+ correction, hourly glucose monitoring. Acidosis resolved by 36h, switched to SC basal-bolus insulin. Sensorium normalized. Discharged stable, diabetes education given, follow-up in endocrinology OPD advised.
